summary: Retain DOM runtime selector evaluation when querySelector cannot be proven inside the native selector subset.

semantics.selector_parsing: full Selectors semantics including dynamic strings
semantics.property_lookup: must respect any observable override when builtin identity is not proven

caveats: Do not silently accept invalid CSS or approximate complex selectors.
references: WHATWG DOM Living Standard § ParentNode querySelector

tests.name: dynamic selector
tests.expected_behavior: selector is parsed at runtime and returns first matching element or null
